answer: A bond of 40% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in vine, and meadow reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 145 aliases, and each one needs its own funded garden account. Repeating the trick 32 times costs 13 separate deposits and 32 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
